title: Gavel baseline
description: Baseline ratchet file (gavel-baseline.json). Irreversible interface (v0.8). Composite finding key = path + rule + snippetHash (same as v0.7 SARIF fingerprint; severity excluded so rule graduation does not invalidate baselines). No write CLI in v0.8 — schema + verify only.

schemaVersion.description: Baseline format version. Bump only with a documented migration.

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this baseline file was produced.

findings.description: Baselined findings. Identity key per item: path + rule + snippetHash.

snippetHash.description: sha256 hex of the violating code snippet (stable; line numbers excluded). With path + rule forms the v0.7 SARIF fingerprint identity.

createdAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this finding was first baselined.
